newsitem.title: USA: Magna Group acquisition wins approval.
newsitem.headline: Magna Group acquisition wins approval.

text.p: Magna Group Inc said Wednesday the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis approved its application to acquire Homeland Bankshares of Waterloo, Iowa.

Under terms of the agreement, Magna will issue 5,038,934 shares of common stock and $92 million in cash in exchange for all outstanding shares of Homeland's common stock. The proposed transaction has a current total market value of about $235 million.
Homeland shareholders are scheduled to vote on the transaction January 21, 1997, with closing expected during the first quarter of 1997.

"Today's proposal brings us one step closer to finalizing our acquisition of Homeland," said Magna chairman G. Thomas Andes. "Following the close of the transaction, Magna will have assets of approximately $6.6 billion and a three-state franchise with locations in Missouri, Illinois and Iowa."
